hero.title: About My12Photos
hero.subtitle: Discover a global photography community where creativity is celebrated, stories are shared, and talented photographers compete for monthly recognition and cash prizes.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: My12Photos was created with a simple idea—to give photographers of every skill level a place to showcase their creativity, tell visual stories, and gain recognition. Unlike traditional photo-sharing platforms, My12Photos brings photographers together through exciting monthly competitions, transparent voting, and a supportive global community.
story.p2: Whether you're capturing breathtaking landscapes, unforgettable moments, or creative storytelling through albums, our platform helps your work reach a wider audience.
story.quote: Every photographer should have a fair stage to present their visual timeline. We designed My12Photos as that global amphitheater.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: Our mission is to inspire creativity by providing a modern, fair, and engaging photography competition platform where every photographer has an equal opportunity to be recognized.
mission.p2: We aim to make photography competitions simple, transparent, and enjoyable while rewarding participants for their passion and creativity.
mission.highlight: Fair Play, Transparent Voting & High Engagement

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.p1: We aspire to become one of the world's leading online photography competition platforms, connecting photographers from around the globe and building a vibrant community driven by creativity, recognition, and continuous participation.

competitionDetails.title: Minimalist Monochrome
competitionDetails.description: A young man walking confidently along a quiet city street during golden hour, wearing a casual white t-shirt, black jeans, and clean white sneakers. His hands are relaxed by his sides, with a natural walking posture and a calm expression. Soft sunlight creates warm highlights and long shadows on the pavement. Modern buildings, green trees, and a slightly blurred urban background add depth to the scene. Captured in a cinematic, photorealistic style with shallow depth of field, ultra-realistic, high detail, 8K quality.

cmt0001.name: Elena Vasquez
cmt0001.comment: Absolutely breathtaking composition! The way the light hits the mountain ridge is pure magic. This deserves to be in a gallery.

cmt0002.name: Marcus Chen
cmt0002.comment: The reflection in the puddle creates a perfect symmetry. Love the monochrome treatment.

cmt0003.name: Priya Sharma
cmt0003.comment: Buy my preset pack! 50% off today only. DM me for discount code 🔥🔥🔥

cmt0004.name: James Okafor
cmt0004.comment: The colors are incredibly vivid. Did you use any filters or is this straight out of camera?

cmt0005.name: Sofia Andersson
cmt0005.comment: This is stolen from another photographer. I saw this exact shot on 500px last month.

cmt0006.name: Yuki Tanaka
cmt0006.comment: The depth of field is perfect here. You can almost feel the petals falling. Stunning mastery of the 85mm lens.

cmt0007.name: Ahmed Al-Rashid
cmt0007.comment: Terrible editing. The sky looks completely fake and over-processed. Stop using presets like everyone else.

cmt0008.name: Isabelle Laurent
cmt0008.comment: The refraction inside the droplet shows an entire landscape. This is technically extraordinary. Which lens + extension tube did you use?

cmt0009.name: Kofi Mensah
cmt0009.comment: Beautiful subject and lighting. The catchlights in the eyes are perfectly placed.

cmt0010.name: Natalia Petrov
cmt0010.comment: Follow me back please I followed you already!! Check my portfolio!!!

cmt0011.name: Luca Bianchi
cmt0011.comment: The mist over the canal creates such an ethereal atmosphere. This would work beautifully as a large format print.

cmt0012.name: Amara Diallo
cmt0012.comment: This tree is near my village! I recognize it immediately. So proud to see it featured here.
